correctness.rationale: The 1-limited condition becomes two exact per-vertex bit inequalities on a twisted two-row ladder; the trace with row-swap closure counts each labelled complement once. Exact 16-state transfer block determinants are independently recreated and proved by Newton identities in the included verifier, and trace-log/degree extraction yields the full polynomial and trichotomy. The cut-edge bound excludes all smaller sizes. Direct enumeration verifies every coefficient for n=3..9 as extra evidence, not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The complete all-size polynomial of an infinite, natural twisted cubic family is a meaningful exact combinatorial invariant; it sharply determines a four-divisibility threshold and all optimum multiplicities. Neither a coarse general lower bound nor a finite table provides these enumerative/structural results, and the explicit transfer description supports future comparisons to untwisted prisms and related cubic circulants.
